`DECOMP 2 2 1 []` — src == dst = 2! So `route_max(2, 2, ...)` was called. So in `_deliver`, u == w happened. How?

`cands = [u for u in senders_all if have[u] > 0]` — senders_all includes v and all others. And `for w in order` — order is the list of others. So u could equal w if w is in senders_all and have[w] > 0! Yes! Once `have[w] > 0` (partially delivered), w itself is a "sender" candidate, and routing from w to w is nonsense.

Fix: skip u == w in the candidates.
